aoa-decision.notes: Advertised decision family; record and correct effects still require owner authority.

aoa-engineering-shape.notes: Deferred source package for explicit research or repository consumers; produces a proposed boundary and never claims owner adoption. Current manual evidence does not justify OS user discovery.

aoa-eval.notes: Advertised challenger; manual trials established necessary apply-contract discipline while all five procedures retain bounded proof and effect limits.

aoa-verification.notes: Deferred source package for explicit research or repository consumers; manual evidence and owner meaning precede durable automation. Current manual evidence and coexistence do not justify OS user discovery.

aoa-knowledge-stewardship.notes: Advertised challenger; sanitized-share adds fail-closed pre-raw and publication boundaries, while authority-map preserves the old functional baseline and routes current source conflicts away from aoa-decision.

aoa-checkpoint-closeout-bridge.notes: Advertised transitional front door; execute requires closed reviewed current-session evidence and stops before owner or playbook effects.

aoa-memo-writeback.notes: Advertised first-writeback front door; creates at most one guarded local candidate and hands existing memo artifacts to aoa-memo.

aoa-session-harvest.notes: Advertised challenger; natural automation-readiness work otherwise bypassed its typed posture, checkpoint, and owner-handoff contract.

aoa-session-recovery.notes: Advertised challenger after natural reviewed-failure retrieval and one-off negative trials; diagnosis is read-only, while repair may act only through an authorized owner binding with checkpoint, rollback, bounded attempts, and observed health verification.
